QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] The Fall of Captain Blood
QuestInfo.0: Your fight with Grosso Polpo almost made you forget about Captain Blood... until the Robed Lady reminded you.
QuestInfo.1: Captain Blood sped away, floating off into the horizon... that guy is definitely the pirate king.
QuestInfo.2: The man once called the Pirate King has been taken down by an unnamed Robed Lady...
